svg.title: Countable anatomy of the strict lower-deviation event
svg.desc: For one fixed lower rational margin, each cutoff requests a later positive witness. All cutoffs form an arbitrarily-late event. The countable union over rational margins below the target forms the strict event.
svg.text: Three countable layers encode one durable gap
Witness length may change with the cutoff; the chosen margin may not.
Choose a later positive length whose centered value crosses the fixed lower margin.
The same margin receives witnesses arbitrarily late, with gaps allowed between them.
Layer 3: rational margins below the real target
A countable union detects any durable strict gap while preserving null measurability.
COUNTABLE: natural cutoffs / natural lengths / rational margins
